mr_title: Pass CA and client TLS certificates to build subprocesses
mr_description:
The _PIP_STANDALONE_CERT environment variable hack is no longer required
as pip doesn't run a zip archive of itself to provision build dependencies
these days (which due to a CPython bug would leave behind temporary certifi
files).

Some people do depend on this private envvar in the wild, so the removal
has been called out in the news entry.

expected_issues.title: Implicit certificate bundle overrides subprocess CA selection
expected_issues.description:
The build-dependency subprocess now always receives --cert, substituting certifi's bundle when the user supplied no custom certificate. This changes the child's default certificate selection instead of merely forwarding an explicit parent option.

The linked upstream correction reports loss of system-CA support and failures in environments relying on corporate CAs; it removes the implicit bundle argument and forwards --cert only when explicitly configured. That correction explicitly contains no truststore regression test. The unconditional argument is verified in this snapshot, but the TLS integration outcome was not reproduced in this audit; do not equate the presence of --cert with the truststore SSLContext never being constructed.
